summary: Trivial forwarder that acquires a synchronization lock by calling CriticalSectionLazyInitEnter with lock slot index 13 and returns its result. The ABI lead labels this function Lock_Acquire_by_Index.

operations.description: Call CriticalSectionLazyInitEnter(0x58DFEA) with constant lock index 13; its return value is the function result.
Return the value produced by CriticalSectionLazyInitEnter unchanged.

unresolved: The subsystem owning critical-section slot 13 is unknown; the constant has no packet evidence linking it to a named resource.
Why callers sub_587AC0 and sub_589CC6 route lock acquisition through this indirection instead of calling CriticalSectionLazyInitEnter directly is unresolved.
